name: independent pores filled by capillary condensation
question: Does a porous solid return to the same set of filled pores when the vapour pressure comes back to an earlier turning point?
assumptions: Each pore is an element that fills when the chemical potential of the vapour exceeds its condensation threshold and empties at a lower evaporation threshold
The pores do not interact: there are no couplings
The thresholds are spread by the distribution of pore sizes: the centres of the pore loops are Gaussian with width 1, and their half-widths uniform between 0.1 and 0.8
The chemical potential changes slowly; thermal activation over the barrier between filled and empty states is neglected

provenance.source: independent elements with loops of their own: F. Preisach, Z. Phys. 94, 277 (1935); I. D. Mayergoyz, Mathematical Models of Hysteresis (Springer, 1991)
